definitions.explanation: An artificial wall or bank, typically of earth or concrete, built along a river or coast to prevent flooding.

examples.english: To walk along the river embankment.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大雨|おおあめ}→大雨：03015_ooame⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{堤防|ていぼう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{決壊|けっかい}→決壊：15288_kekkai⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧おそれ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There is a risk of the levee breaking due to heavy rain.

examples.japanese: ⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{備|そな}えて→備える：02125_sonaeru⟧、{堤防|ていぼう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{強化|きょうか}→強化：00260_kyouka⟧⟦{工事|こうじ}→工事：00244_kouji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{進|すす}められている→進める：01949_susumeru⟧。
examples.english: Construction to reinforce the embankment is underway in preparation for typhoons.

notes:
{堤防|ていぼう} refers to man-made structures for flood prevention, built along rivers, coasts, or lakes.
